mode.description: 'inline' = the keypad is always shown. 'popover' opens it from a trigger (a later milestone; treated as inline for now).

decimals.description: Maximum decimal places. 0 = integer only (the decimal key is disabled).

enforceRange.description: Clamp the committed value to [min, max] and report output.isValid. When false, min/max are ignored.

min.description: Lower bound (used only when enforceRange is true).

max.description: Upper bound (used only when enforceRange is true).

units.description: Engineering-unit suffix shown after the value (e.g. 'psi', '°C').

showValue.description: Show the value display above the keypad.

liveUpdate.description: Write value.value on every key press (not only on Enter). onCommit still fires on Enter.

locale.description: Default UI-text language (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt), matched on the primary subtag. Empty follows the session.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

value.description: The committed number — the source of truth. The keypad edits a local draft and writes this back on Enter (persist it from onCommit to survive a reload).
The current committed value (clamped when enforceRange).

text.description: The value formatted with decimals + units.

isValid.description: Whether the value is within [min, max] (always true when enforceRange is false).

draft.description: The in-progress edit string ('' when not editing).
